generated_plan.title: 10-Month Full Stack Developer Learning Plan (Python/Django Focus)
generated_plan.goal: Become a Full Stack Developer (Software Engineering) for the global remote job market, leveraging Python and Django.
prerequisites: Familiar with Python, C, C++, Kotlin, JavaScript

topics: Django REST Framework (DRF): Core concepts, serializers, views, routers.
Authentication: Token-based (JWT), Session-based.
Permissions & Filtering in DRF.
PostgreSQL: Basic SQL queries, database design, Django ORM advanced features.
Git: Advanced concepts (branching, merging, pull requests).
activities: Build a multi-resource REST API (e.g., Blog API, Task Manager API) using Django and DRF.
Implement user authentication and basic permissions.
Practice database queries directly in SQL and via Django ORM.
Consistent Git usage for project versioning.
monthly_breakdown.output: Fully functional Django REST API with authentication.

monthly_breakdown.focus: Core Frontend Fundamentals (HTML, CSS, Modern JavaScript)
topics: HTML5: Semantic HTML, accessibility basics.
CSS3: Responsive design (Flexbox, Grid), SASS/SCSS basics (optional but good).
JavaScript (ES6+): Asynchronous JS (Promises, async/await), DOM manipulation, modern features (destructuring, spread/rest).
activities: Recreate a responsive webpage from scratch using only HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript.
Solve small to medium JavaScript coding challenges (e.g., HackerRank 'Easy' JS problems).
Practice using browser developer tools effectively.
monthly_breakdown.output: Strong foundation in modern web frontend technologies.

topics: React Fundamentals: Components (functional), JSX, props, state (useState).
React Hooks: useEffect for side effects, useContext for state sharing.
Conditional rendering, list rendering.
Basic React Router DOM for client-side navigation.
activities: Build a simple single-page application (SPA) using React (e.g., a simple to-do list, calculator).
Experiment with component composition and state management patterns.
Familiarize with the React development environment.
monthly_breakdown.output: Basic React application, understanding of core React concepts.

monthly_breakdown.focus: Full Stack Integration (React + Django REST API)
topics: Making API calls from React: Fetch API or Axios.
Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration.
Implementing user authentication (login/logout/registration) on the React frontend, interacting with the Django DRF backend.
Error handling for API requests.
activities: Integrate the React app with the Django DRF API built in Month 1.
Implement a complete user authentication flow (signup, login, logout).
Display data fetched from the backend on the frontend.
Debug full-stack interactions.
monthly_breakdown.output: A fully integrated full-stack application (frontend + backend).

topics: Backend Deployment: Heroku, Render, or basic AWS EC2 setup (Gunicorn, Nginx). Dockerizing Django (basic Dockerfile).
Frontend Deployment: Netlify, Vercel, or GitHub Pages.
Environment variables management.
Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) concepts (e.g., automated deployments on push).
activities: Deploy the integrated full-stack application to production.
Set up a simple CI/CD pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions for auto-deploy).
Understand domain configuration and basic SSL/TLS.
monthly_breakdown.output: Your full-stack application live on the internet, familiarity with deployment processes.

topics: Big O Notation: Time and Space Complexity analysis.
Common Data Structures: Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Hash Maps/Tables.
Basic Algorithms: Sorting (Bubble, Insertion, Selection), Searching (Linear, Binary).
activities: Solve 3-4 LeetCode 'Easy' problems per week in Python.
Review theoretical concepts of each data structure and algorithm.
Implement basic data structures from scratch for understanding.
monthly_breakdown.output: Solid understanding of fundamental DSA concepts and ability to solve basic problems.

topics: Trees: Binary Trees, Binary Search Trees (BST), Tree traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder).
Graphs: Representation (Adjacency List/Matrix), Basic traversals (BFS, DFS).
Recursion: Understanding recursive solutions, base cases.
Introduction to Dynamic Programming (basic problems).
activities: Solve 2-3 LeetCode 'Medium' problems per week in Python.
Practice explaining your thought process and algorithmic choices.
Focus on problem-solving strategies rather than just memorizing solutions.
monthly_breakdown.output: Improved problem-solving skills and readiness for intermediate DSA questions.

topics: Django: Caching strategies (Redis), Celery for asynchronous tasks, advanced ORM queries, unit/integration testing (Pytest).
React: Performance optimization (memoization, lazy loading), advanced state management (Redux/Zustand basics), testing (Jest, React Testing Library).
Web Security: OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and prevention strategies in Django/React.
activities: Enhance one of your existing projects with advanced features (e.g., implement search, add background tasks, add robust error logging).
Write unit and integration tests for key parts of your application.
Review common security practices.
monthly_breakdown.output: More robust and professionally structured portfolio project.

monthly_breakdown.focus: System Design Basics & New Portfolio Project
topics: System Design Fundamentals: Scalability, load balancing, database choices (relational vs. NoSQL), caching, message queues, microservices vs. monolith (high-level).
Clean Code Principles: SOLID, DRY, KISS, design patterns.
Software Architecture: Understanding common patterns for web applications.
activities: Start building a new, more ambitious portfolio project from scratch, applying all learned full-stack skills and best practices. This project should stand out.
Study common system design questions (e.g., design Twitter, design URL shortener).
Refine code quality and project documentation (READMEs).
monthly_breakdown.output: Understanding of basic system design, substantial and well-documented new portfolio project.

topics: Resume and LinkedIn Optimization: Tailor for remote full-stack roles.
Behavioral Interview Questions: STAR method.
Technical Interview Practice: Whiteboard coding, conceptual questions (Django, React, JS, DB).
Networking and Job Application Strategies.
activities: Daily LeetCode practice (mix of Easy/Medium).
Conduct mock interviews (self-recorded or with peers).
Actively apply for remote full-stack developer positions, tailoring applications.
Refine portfolio project READMEs and prepare to present them.
monthly_breakdown.output: Prepared for job interviews, active job search, optimized professional presence.

general_advice: Consistency: Dedicate exactly 1 hour every day. Even 30 minutes is better than skipping.
Active Learning: Code along, experiment, debug. Avoid 'tutorial hell'.
Focus on Depth: Master core concepts rather than trying to learn too many technologies superficially.
Leverage Existing Knowledge: Your CSE background and existing Python/Django familiarity are huge assets.
Build Projects: Your portfolio projects are your resume. Aim for 2-3 solid, well-documented projects by the end.
Practice Explaining: For DSA and System Design, practice verbalizing your thought process.
Networking: Join online developer communities, follow industry leaders.
Stay Updated: The web development landscape changes rapidly; follow reputable blogs and news sources.
English Communication: Crucial for global remote roles. Practice clear written and verbal communication.

django: Django for APIs by William S. Vincent
system_design: Grokking the System Design Interview (Educative.io - if budget allows, otherwise blogs/YouTube)
deployment_devops: Official documentation for Heroku, Netlify, Vercel, Docker
